filing_primary_label: INDEPENDENTLY-COMPUTED (LibreOffice). Its derived cells were computed by an implementation this project did not write — NOT by a person, and NOT by Excel. It is the plan's E6 substitute and it is weaker than E6 in two named ways: LibreOffice is not Excel, so a disagreement is a third answer rather than a verdict against us; and it is a spreadsheet engine, not a reader of the regulation, so it cannot notice that a formula is wrong.
filing_smoke_label: SMOKE ONLY — NON-GATING — NON-DISCRIMINATING (arithmetic). src/cdfc/calc/ wrote this filing's derived cells, and the arithmetic predicates assert exactly the identities calc/ enforced when it did. The oracle and the system under test are the same function, so a zero here is x == x. It may not be cited in a gate, in a severity tier, or in any published rate.
